notes.title: The demo of the super abstract indie game "Escape From kiss" is now available!
notes.content:
Under the pursuit of an obsessive admirer, memorize the first cabin and quickly identify differences in the other cabins.
[u][b]Speed up if you don't want to be kissed by this admirer![/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576948/db462f6cd16e45fb15f306049ac4576af9c9ba93.png[/img]
If you're interested, [b][u]add it to your wishlist[/u][/b]!
